Concours Media Star 2026 : un appel à ca: Media Star 2026 Contest: Call for applications open until the end of August
ALGER — Ooredoo Algérie a lancé un rappe: ALGIERS — Ooredoo Algeria has issued a reminder to journalists wishing to participate in the 19th edition of Media Star. The final deadline to submit their application is set for August 31, 2026, after which the submission portal will be permanently closed.
Le thème retenu pour cette édition met e: The chosen theme for this edition highlights a major current issue: "the impact of artificial intelligence and 5G technology on social and economic transformations in Algeria." This topic aligns with the challenges posed by contemporary technological innovations.
Pour participer, les candidats doivent t: To participate, candidates must submit their files via the dedicated digital platform, accessible via the link ore.do/media-star-participation. An alternative is also offered by sending an email to Mediastar@Ooredoo.dz. Eligible works must have been published or broadcast by Algerian media between August 15, 2025, and August 31, 2026, in one of the four official languages: Arabic, Tamazight, French, or English.
Les candidats peuvent consulter l'intégr: Candidates can consult the complete contest rules and detailed instructions on the Ooredoo website, in the "all about Ooredoo" section, under the "Media Star" subsection. For any questions or requests for clarification, the operator's media relations department remains available via the email address Rpubliques@ooredoo.dz.
